claim_text: Claimant admitted to St. Jude Hospital for 3 days due to acute viral pneumonia. Underwent IV antibiotic therapy, chest X-rays, blood cultures, and 3 nights in standard single room. Total hospital bill $3,450.
evaluation_notes: Standard covered inpatient treatment minus $250 deductible.

claim_text: Patient underwent elective phacoemulsification cataract surgery for the right eye with monofocal intraocular lens insertion at City Eye Institute. Total procedure bill is $2,100.
evaluation_notes: Approved but capped at the $1,200 sub-limit specified in Clause 3.2.

claim_text: Claimant hospitalized for acute ischemic stroke and secondary hypertension. Medical records reveal ongoing treatment for chronic hypertension diagnosed 18 months prior to policy inception. Current policy active for 8 months.
evaluation_notes: Pre-existing condition within 36-month exclusion waiting period.

evaluation_notes: High value claim exceeding $10,000 threshold and subject to Joint Replacement Sub-Limit.

claim_text: Insured vehicle collided with concrete guardrail during heavy rain. Front bumper shattered, radiator ruptured, hood crumpled. Vehicle towed to authorized repair centre.
evaluation_notes: Standard collision covered minus $350 deductible and 50% depreciation on plastic bumper.

claim_text: Gravel airborne from highway truck struck front windshield causing extensive spiderweb cracking. Replacement of original OEM laminated windshield.
evaluation_notes: Glass components carry 0% depreciation deduction under Clause 2.2.

evaluation_notes: Strictly excluded under Clause 3.1 for driving while intoxicated.

evaluation_notes: Valid total theft claim but exceeds $10k threshold, requiring senior adjuster sign-off.

claim_text: Internal second-floor bathroom copper supply pipe burst suddenly due to freezing temperatures, causing ceiling collapse and structural drywall flooding into ground floor living room.
evaluation_notes: Sudden bursting covered minus $500 property deductible.

claim_text: Homeowner reported mold growth and rotting baseboards in basement. Certified building inspector concluded damage resulted from continuous rainwater capillary seepage over 2 years.
evaluation_notes: Gradual long-term seepage and maintenance failure excluded under Clause 3.1.

evaluation_notes: High value claim ($28.5k) routed to human adjuster for contractor quote validation.

evaluation_notes: Mysterious disappearance and unforced loss excluded under Clause 3.1.
